# Download modules and populate go.sum.
bolero get -modcacherw
exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod

# 'bolero mod verify' should fail if we delete a file.
bolero mod verify
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod
! bolero mod verify

# Create a .partial file to simulate an failure extracting the zip file.
cp empty $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.5.2.partial

# 'bolero mod verify' should not fail, since the module hasn't been completely
# ingested into the cache.
bolero mod verify

# 'bolero list' should not load packages from the directory.
# NOTE: the message "directory $dir outside main module or its selected dependencies"
# is reported for directories not in the main module, active modules in the
# module cache, or local replacements. In this case, the directory is in the
# right place, but it's incomplete, so 'bolero list' acts as if it's not an
# active module.
! bolero list $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
stderr 'outside main module or its selected dependencies'

# 'bolero list -m' should not print the directory.
bolero list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' rsc.io/quote
! stdout .

# 'bolero mod download' should re-extract the module and remove the .partial file.
bolero mod download -modcacherw rsc.io/quote
! exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.5.2.partial
exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod

# 'bolero list' should succeed.
bolero list $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
stdout '^rsc.io/quote$'

# 'bolero list -m' should print the directory.
bolero list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' rsc.io/quote
stdout 'pkg[/\\]mod[/\\]rsc.io[/\\]quote@v1.5.2'

# bolero mod verify should fail if we delete a file.
bolero mod verify
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2/go.mod
! bolero mod verify

# 'bolero mod download' should not leave behind a directory or a .partial file
# if there is an error extracting the zip file.
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
cp empty $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.5.2.zip
! bolero mod download
stderr 'not a valid zip file'
! exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
! exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.5.2.partial

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.14

require rsc.io/quote v1.5.2

-- use.go --
package use

import _ "rsc.io/quote"

-- empty --
